Score every candidate pair between two single-year frames

score_year_pair.Rd

Blocks on organization, compares the configured fields, and returns the surname-frequency-adjusted score for every candidate pair (no threshold, no selection). Shared by link_year_pairs() and candidate_scores() so the two can never drift apart.

Usage

score_year_pair(dx, dy, feats, comparators, weights)

Arguments

dx, dy

Prepared single-year frames (subsets of a prepare_panel() work frame).

feats

Feature column names to compare.

comparators

Comparator list from match_comparators().

weights

Named base weights.

Value

A data frame with ix, iy (row indices into dx, dy) and score, or NULL if there are no candidate pairs.
